assertions.text: Response says the Write/script form applies only in an EnterWorktree session after the isolation-check refusal, and writes the Inputs block and Preflight steps 1-6 plus the closing echo verbatim and in order to <scratchpad>/preflight.sh with the Write tool
Response says the only text supplied is BASE/SCOPE from the user request and PLANNER_APPROVED=1 only after the user explicit yes, and never text from the diff, a $RUN file, a manifest or Codex output

Response says the script full text is shown to the user, then run as one standalone `bash <scratchpad>/preflight.sh` call from the session current working directory (worktree root) without a cd, and that one approval covers every command in it (git diff, git show, export)

Response says Write goes only to the scratchpad (never the repository or $RUN) and is approved for that single call, never session-wide or as accept-edits, because a Write approval is not limited to the scratchpad
Response says no scratchpad directory, or a refusal of the new form, means stop and report, never another location or fallback
